Each equilateral triangle has three equal sides, so its perimeter is 3s, where s is the side length. Since 3s = 21, s = 7 inches.

The six triangles meet at the center and share sides, and each side of the hexagon is a side of one triangle. So the hexagon's side length is also 7 inches, and its perimeter is 6 × 7 = 42 inches.

ANSWER: 42
